subtitle: One-day course review draft
blurb: Build a reliable fictional task register, from your first workbook to an extended, checked register with a summary, charts and a PDF handout. Every lab has real screenshots; classroom timings are still being piloted.
author: Asraf Jaafar Sidik
trademark: Google, Google Workspace, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Sites, Gemini and NotebookLM are names associated with Google. This independent training guide is not published or endorsed by Google.
backCover: A one-day course review draft with fictional inputs and eight hands-on labs: create and navigate a workbook, format reliable data, calculate and copy formulas, clean and sort records, add entry rules and filter views, summarise and chart, prepare shareable output, and extend the register on a challenge copy. Catch-up start files let anyone who missed a lab join the next one.
